step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify Nodes: Map components from the whiteboard visual inventory and spoken transcript to AWS/actor services. Node 0 is the external '3 mil Partner' (ThirdParty). Node 1 is the Ingestion Lambda function (Lambda). Node 2 is the Chunk Queue (SQS). Node 3 is the Processing & Enrichment Lambda function (Lambda). Node 4 is the Aurora DB (Aurora). Node 5 is the ML Endpoint (SageMaker). Node 6 is the Notification Topic (SNS). Node 7 is the Fanout Queue (SQS). Node 8 is the Talent Platform Containers (ECS).
2. Identify Flows & Sequences:
- Flow 0: Ingestion of job data from external partner endpoints via cron triggers, splitting large job payloads into chunks and queuing them in SQS (Partner -> Ingestion Lambda -> Chunk SQS).
- Flow 1: Processing, ML enrichment, and persistence into relational storage (Chunk SQS -> Processing Lambda -> ML Endpoint -> Processing Lambda -> Aurora DB).
- Flow 2: Event notification and distribution to downstream consumer containers (Processing Lambda -> SNS Topic -> Fanout Queue -> ECS Containers).
3. Translate into valid JSON adhering strictly to structural, field type, and vocabulary rules.

graph.name: HeyJobs Serverless Job Data Ingestion and Processing Pipeline
graph.categories: Serverless Data Ingestion ML Processing Event-Driven Architecture
graph.notes: HeyJobs processes ~3 million job records daily using a serverless architecture, reducing costs by up to 30% while scaling dynamically.

nodes.name: Partner
nodes.notes: External data partner providing endpoints with job listings (~3M records/day).

nodes.name: Ingestion Lambda
nodes.notes: Triggered via cron/EventBridge, pulls raw payloads from partners and splits them into smaller chunks.

nodes.name: Chunk Queue
nodes.notes: Queues smaller job data chunks to buffer spikes and control downstream load.

nodes.name: Processing & Enrichment Lambda
nodes.notes: Consumes chunks from SQS, normalizes data schema, verifies quality, interacts with SageMaker for ML enrichment, and writes to DB/SNS.

nodes.name: Aurora DB
nodes.notes: Stores normalized and enriched job listing records.

nodes.name: ML Endpoint
nodes.notes: Uses NLP and ML models to enrich and categorize sparse job data.

nodes.name: Notification Topic
nodes.notes: Receives notifications after data is processed and enriched, fanning out messages.

nodes.name: Fanout Queue
nodes.notes: Receives fanout messages from SNS for consumption by downstream services.

nodes.name: Talent Platform Containers
nodes.notes: Containerized application consuming SQS messages and serving web frontend search/filtering.

edges.notes: Ingestion Lambda pulls raw data payloads from Partner endpoints.
Ingestion Lambda pushes data chunks to the SQS queue.
Processing Lambda consumes chunked messages from SQS.
Processing Lambda sends sparse job text to ML Endpoint for classification and NLP enrichment.
ML Endpoint returns enriched categorization data back to Processing Lambda.
Processing Lambda stores enriched job records in Aurora DB.
Processing Lambda publishes notification event to SNS Topic upon successful processing.
SNS Topic fans out notifications to SQS queues.
ECS containers consume messages from SQS to update Talent Platform database and frontend search index.
